changelog.body:
First store listing. Dynamic-Island-style capsule for the front camera hole: notifications, media + ambient ring, calls with answer/end, download progress, charging, privacy dots, screen-recording capsule, face-unlock sweep, Game Space / fullscreen stand-down, and an automation API. Built and tested on OPPO A79 5G (CPH2553), ColorOS 13.1 / Android 13, LSPosed 2.2.1, libxposed API 102. See the compatibility table in README.md before installing on other ROMs.

readme:
# Halo

A Dynamic-Island-style pill for Android phones with a centred camera hole-punch — written from
scratch as an [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) module, tuned for ColorOS 13 on the
OPPO A79 5G (CPH2553).

One APK holds both halves: the module that injects a single overlay window into
`com.android.systemui`, and the settings app that configures it. No AndroidX, no Compose, no
tracking, no network permission. Everything is drawn on a `Canvas`.

```
  ┌───────────────────────────┐
  │  ◉  Rafiq · order 4192    │   ← capsule, expands from the camera hole
  │      56%                  │
  └───────────────────────────┘
```

## See it first

Every picture below is generated by `sh tools/capture-gallery.sh` from the app's own synthetic test
states, so nothing in them is anyone's real message.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![capsule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/capsule.png) | **A message arrives.** The hole widens into a capsule: app icon or sender photo, subject, and a bell when the row is silent. Swipe up on it to dismiss. |
| ![list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/list-card.png) | **A burst of them.** Four rows stack under a shaking bell, each one swipes away on its own; the count in the header follows. |
| ![detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/detail-card.png) | **One tap to read.** The paragraph wraps to the width of the card and the notification's own buttons become chips — Reply, Mark as read, Open all fire the real intents. |
| ![download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/download.png) | **Something is actually transferring.** A green line and a percentage, and only when the app declares a scale and the row is a running task. |
| ![call](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/call-card.png) | **An incoming call.** Answer and hang up as discs; once you answer, the same slot folds into a green ring. |
| ![ring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/media-ring.png) | **Nothing else is happening.** A light sweeps around the hole while music plays; tap it for the player. |
| ![settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/settings.png) | **The settings app.** Grouped cards, switches that behave like iPhone's, and a sheet for every number. |

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| **Notifications** | The newest message expands the hole into a capsule: sender photo or initial, subject, a bell for silent rows. Swipe up to dismiss. |
| **A burst of messages** | Three or four rows stack into a list card with a shaking bell on the left; each row swipes away on its own. |
| **One tap to open** | A single message opens a detail card with the paragraph word-wrapped and the notification's own action buttons as chips (Reply / Mark as read / Open). |
| **Media** | Now-playing becomes a floating mini-player with artwork, transport controls and a seek line; while nothing else is up, a light keeps sweeping around the hole. |
| **Downloads** | A real progress bar and `NN%` — only when the app declares a scale and the row is an actual running task. |
| **Calls** | An incoming call gets a card with answer and hang-up discs; after you answer, the same slot becomes a green ring. |
| **Charging** | Percentage, plug/unplug, and a red ring at low battery. |
| **Privacy** | A coloured dot when any app touches the camera, microphone or location — read from SystemUI's own privacy list and AppOps. |
| **Screen recording** | A capsule while a recording is active. |
| **Face unlock** | One sweep of light around the hole when the device unlocks. |
| **Games and fullscreen video** | The island gets out of the way: Game Space's own session flag, and WindowManager's `setTopAppHidesStatusBar`. |
| **Automation** | Any app, Tasker, Termux or `adb` can put a capsule on screen — see the API below. |

## Compatibility — read this before you install

**Built and tested on exactly one phone**: OPPO A79 5G, model **CPH2553**, ColorOS **13.1** over
Android **13**, rooted with Magisk, LSPosed **2.2.1**, libxposed API **102**. Nothing in this
repository has been run anywhere else. There is no compatibility promise for any other Oppo,
Realme, OnePlus or Xiaomi device, and "it's the same OEM" is not a guarantee.

What each part depends on, so you can judge your own device:

| part | depends on | elsewhere |
|---|---|---|
| Geometry of the pill | `WindowInsets.getDisplayCutout()` — measured, never hardcoded | should adapt; the fractions were tuned on a 1080x2400 panel |
| Notification capture | `com.android.systemui.notification.NotifCollection` (AOSP-named) | works on AOSP-derived SystemUI; some forks rename or wrap it |
| Heads-up suppression | `com.oplusos.systemui.notification.helper.HeadsUpHelper` and `SimpleHeadsUpController` | **ColorOS / Realme UI only.** Elsewhere the hook simply never attaches: the island still shows, and the OEM banner shows next to it |
| Hide in games | `Settings.Global/disturb_for_game_space_mode_flag` | **ColorOS only.** Other ROMs read 0 forever and the island stays visible in games |
| Hide in fullscreen video | `CommandQueue#setTopAppHidesStatusBar` | AOSP since Android 11, the most portable of the four |
| Privacy dots | `com.android.systemui.privacy.PrivacyItemController` | AOSP since Android 12, but the package layout moves between releases |
| Media, calls, charging | public framework APIs | portable |
| Sender photos | `android.messages` as a `Bundle[]`, `Person.getName()` | measured on this ROM; other builds may use the real `MessagingStyle` |

Realme UI ships the same Oplus framework as ColorOS, so a Realme phone is the *most likely* to
work — that is an inference from shared code, not a measurement. Android 14 and 15 are untested
and `targetSdk` is 33 on purpose.

If the island does not appear on your device, do this before opening an issue:

```bash
adb shell su -c 'pm grant io.github.lamin_sudo.halo android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS'
adb shell su -c 'settings put global a79_island_debug_log 1'
adb shell su -c 'kill $(pidof com.android.systemui)'
adb logcat -s HaloIsland | head -40
```

The first lines say which hooks attached and which were not found — that output is the useful part
of a report.

## Requirements

- Rooted phone with **LSPosed** (tested on 2.2.1, libxposed API 102) and **Riru/Zygisk** provider.
- Android 13 (minSdk 33). Verified on ColorOS 13.1 / CPH2553. Other OEMs are untested: the hook
  targets are AOSP-named on purpose, but the *geometry* and the heads-up gate are ColorOS-specific.
- The module injects into `com.android.systemui` only. It never touches `system_server`.

## Install

```bash
sh gradlew :app:assembleRelease
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

# give the settings app the one permission it needs to write its own config
adb shell su -c 'pm grant io.github.lamin_sudo.halo android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS'

# reload SystemUI so the hooks attach
adb shell su -c 'kill $(pidof com.android.systemui)'
```

Then open **LSPosed → Modules**, enable *Halo*, set its scope to **SystemUI**, and reboot once.
`tools/install-release.sh` does all of the above, checks the signing certificate, and prints the
LSPosed step it cannot do for you.

## The kill switch

If the island ever misbehaves, no reinstall is needed:

```bash
adb shell su -c 'settings put global a79_island_disabled 1'   # module stands down on next boot of SystemUI
adb shell su -c 'settings put global a79_island_disabled 0'   # back on
```

## Automation API

```bash
adb shell am broadcast -n io.github.lamin_sudo.halo/.CustomReceiver -a io.github.lamin_sudo.halo.CUSTOM \
  --es title "Order shipped" --es text "#4192 to Rafiq" \
  --ei progress 60 --ei ttl 8 --es color 0xFF30D158 --es key order-4192
```

`-n` (or at least `-p io.github.lamin_sudo.halo`) is required — an implicit broadcast to a custom action is
dropped since Android 8. In Tasker, use *Send Broadcast* with the package field filled in. Repeat
the same message and it shows again: the receiver bumps a sequence number, that is the event.

## Settings

Stored in `Settings.Global` under `a79_island_*` because that is the one place the hooked SystemUI
process can read; changes apply live through a `ContentObserver`, no restart.

| key | meaning | default |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | master switch | on |
| `src_notification`, `src_media`, `src_charging`, `privacy` | per-source switches | on |
| `haptics` | buzz on taps and swipes | on |
| `games_hide` | hide while Game Space owns the screen | on |
| `immersive_hide` | hide while the top app hides the status bar | on |
| `hide_heads_up` | suppress ColorOS's own banner | off |
| `ttl_ms` | how long a capsule stays up | 5000 |
| `offset_x`, `offset_y`, `width_scale` | placement, in px and % | 0, 0, 100 |
| `allow_<pkg>` | per-app gate | allowed |
| `debug_log` | verbose logcat under tag `HaloIsland` | off |

## Known limits, stated plainly

- **Recorder with the microphone off is not detected.** ColorOS records without a
  MediaProjection token, so the only signal that survives is the microphone op.
- **Fullscreen detection is per-signal.** Games and "the top app hides the bar" are both real
  WindowManager/Game Space facts. A video that keeps the status bar visible is not fullscreen as
  far as the system is concerned, and the island stays.
- **Rows cannot be swiped away for apps that set no `deleteIntent`** — `NotificationManager`
  offers no public per-key cancel on this build.
- **Sender photos depend on the app.** `android.messages` arrives as a `Parcelable[]` of Bundles
  on this ROM and `Person` exposes `getName()` rather than `getDisplayName()`; apps that send
  neither fall back to the app icon.
- **Battery cost is not measured yet.** `tools/battery-soak.sh` exists (two equal idle windows,
  module off vs the ring sweeping) but has not been run. Until it is, treat the ambient ring as
  unquantified — which is why the media ring only runs while something is actually playing.

## Documentation

- [docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](https://github.com/lamin-sudo/halo/blob/main/docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md) — the hook map, every measurement that shaped it, and the four routes
  that failed before the right signal was found.
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/lamin-sudo/halo/blob/main/NOTICE) — the two external sources, and the line between "measured this device" and
  "copied proprietary code" (there is none of the latter here).
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/lamin-sudo/halo/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — the rules for anyone continuing the work, including the Kotlin/interceptor trap
  that crashed SystemUI twice.

## Licence

MIT. See [NOTICE](https://github.com/lamin-sudo/halo/blob/main/NOTICE) for the third-party work this was built against.

# 光环

适用于 Android 手机的动态岛式药丸，带有居中摄像头打孔 — 编写于
scrap 作为一个 [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) 模块，针对 ColorOS 13 进行了调整
OPPO A79 5G（CPH2553）。

一个 APK 包含两半：将单个覆盖窗口注入到的模块
`com.android.systemui`，以及配置它的设置应用程序。没有 AndroidX，没有 Compose，没有
跟踪，无网络许可。一切都绘制在“画布”上。

````
  ┌────────────────────────────┐
  │ ◉ 拉菲克 · 订单 4192 │ ← 胶囊，从摄像头孔扩展
  │ 56% │
  └────────────────────────────┘
````

## 先看一下

下面的每张图片都是由应用程序自己的综合测试中的“sh tools/capture-gallery.sh”生成的
状态，所以其中没有任何内容是任何人的真实信息。

| | |
|---|---|
| ![胶囊](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/capsule.png) | **一条消息到达。** 该洞扩大为一个胶囊：应用程序图标或发件人照片、主题以及当该行保持沉默时的铃声。向上滑动即可关闭。 |
| ![列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/list-card.png) | **突然爆发。** 四排堆叠在摇晃的铃铛下，每一排都自行滑开；标题中的计数如下。 |
| ![详细](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/detail-card.png) | **一键阅读。** 段落会换行到卡片的宽度，通知本身的按钮变成碎片 - 回复、标记为已读、打开所有火的真实意图。 |
| ![下载](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/download.png) | **确实有东西正在传输。** 绿线和百分比，仅当应用程序声明比例并且该行是正在运行的任务时。 |
| ![call](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/call-card.png) | **来电。** 接听挂断光盘；一旦你回答，同一个槽就会折叠成一个绿色的环。 |
| ![ring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/media-ring.png) | **没有其他事情发生。** 当音乐响起时，灯光在洞周围扫过；为播放器点击它。 |
| ![设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamin-sudo/halo/main/docs/images/settings.png) | **设置应用程序。** 分组卡片、行为类似于 iPhone 的开关以及每个数字的工作表。 |

## 它的作用

| | |
|---|---|
| **通知** |最新的消息将这个洞扩大到一个胶囊：发件人照片或姓名首字母、主题、静音行的铃声。向上滑动即可关闭。 |
| **大量消息** |三或四行堆叠成一张列表卡，左侧有一个摇动的铃铛；每行都会自行滑开。 |
| **一键打开** |一条消息会打开一张详细信息卡，其中段落自动换行，通知本身的操作按钮作为芯片（回复/标记为已读/打开）。 |
| **媒体** |现在播放变成一个浮动的迷你播放器，带有插图、传输控制和搜索线；当没有其他事情发生时，一道光一直扫过洞的周围。 |
| **下载** |真正的进度条和“NN%”——仅当应用程序声明比例并且该行是实际运行的任务时。 |
| **通话** |来电时会收到一张带有接听盘和挂断盘的卡片；接听后，同一个插槽会变成绿环。 |
| **充电** |百分比、插入/拔出以及低电量时的红色环。 |
| **隐私** |当任何应用程序触摸相机、麦克风或位置时，会出现一个彩色点 - 从 SystemUI 自己的隐私列表和 AppOps 中读取。 |
| **屏幕录制** |录音处于活动状态时的胶囊。 |
| **人脸解锁** |设备解锁时，孔周围会发出一扫光。 |
| **游戏和全屏视频** |岛屿让开：Game Space 自己的会话标志和 WindowManager 的“setTopAppHidesStatusBar”。 |
| **自动化** |任何应用程序、Tasker、Termux 或“adb”都可以在屏幕上放置一个胶囊 - 请参阅下面的 API。 |

## 兼容性 — 请先阅读此内容你安装

**仅在一部手机上构建并测试**：OPPO A79 5G，型号 **CPH2553**，ColorOS **13.1** 以上
Android **13**，以 Magisk 为根，LSPod **2.2.1**，libxposed API **102**。这里面什么都没有
存储库已在其他地方运行。没有任何其他 Oppo 的兼容性承诺，
Realme、OnePlus 或小米设备，并且“是同一 OEM”并不能保证。

每个部分都取决于什么，所以你可以判断自己的设备：

|部分|取决于|其他地方 |
|---|---|---|
|药丸的几何形状| `WindowInsets.getDisplayCutout()` — 测量，从未硬编码 |应该适应；分数在 1080x2400 面板上进行调整 |
|通知捕获 | `com.android.systemui.notification.NotifCollection`（AOSP 命名）|适用于 AOSP 派生的 SystemUI；一些分叉重命名或包装它 |
|单挑压制| `com.oplusos.systemui.notification.helper.HeadsUpHelper` 和 `SimpleHeadsUpController` | **仅限 ColorOS / Realme UI。** 在其他地方，挂钩根本不会连接：岛仍然显示，并且 OEM 横幅显示在旁边 |
|隐藏在游戏中 | `Settings.Global/disturb_for_game_space_mode_flag` | **仅限 ColorOS。** 其他 ROM 永远读取 0，并且该岛在游戏中保持可见 |
|隐藏全屏视频 | `CommandQueue#setTopAppHidesStatusBar` | Android 11 以来 AOSP，四者中最便携的 |
|隐私点 | `com.android.systemui.privacy.PrivacyItemController` |自 Android 12 起 AOSP，但包布局在版本之间发生变化 |
|媒体、通话、充电 |公共框架API |便携式|
|发件人照片 | `android.messages` 作为 `Bundle[]`、`Person.getName()` |在此 ROM 上测量；其他版本可能会使用真正的“MessagingStyle” |

Realme UI 搭载与 ColorOS 相同的 Oplus 框架，因此 Realme 手机“最有可能”
工作——这是对共享代码的推断，而不是测量。 Android 14 和 15 未经测试
而 `targetSdk` 是故意设置为 33 的。

如果您的设备上没有出现该岛，请在提出问题之前执行以下操作：

````bash
adb shell su -c 'pm grant io.github.lamin_sudo.halo android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS'
adb shell su -c '设置全局 a79_island_debug_log 1'
adb shell su -c 'kill $(pidof com.android.systemui)'
adb logcat -s 光环岛 |头-40
````

第一行说明了哪些钩子已连接以及哪些钩子未找到 - 该输出是有用的部分
的一份报告。

## 要求

- 使用 **LSPosed**（在 2.2.1、libxposed API 102 上测试）和 **Riru/Zygisk** 提供商获取 Root 权限的手机。
- Android 13（minSdk 33）。在 ColorOS 13.1 / CPH2553 上验证。其他 OEM 未经测试：挂钩
  目标是故意以 AOSP 命名的，但*几何*和平视门是 ColorOS 特定的。
- 该模块仅注入“com.android.systemui”。它永远不会触及“system_server”。

## 安装

````bash
sh gradlew :app:assembleRelease
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

# 为设置应用程序提供编写自己的配置所需的一项权限
adb shell su -c 'pm grant io.github.lamin_sudo.halo android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS'

# 重新加载 SystemUI，以便挂接钩子
adb shell su -c 'kill $(pidof com.android.systemui)'
````

然后打开**LSPosed → Modules**，启用*Halo*，将其范围设置为**SystemUI**，然后重新启动一次。
`tools/install-release.sh` 执行上述所有操作，检查签名证书，并打印
LSPod 步骤它不能为你做。

## 终止开关

如果岛屿出现异常，则无需重新安装：

````bash
adb shell su -c 'settings put global a79_island_disabled 1' # 模块在下次启动 SystemUI 时停止运行
adb shell su -c '设置将全局 a79_island_disabled 0' # 重新打开
````

## 自动化API

````bash
adb shell am 广播 -n io.github.lamin_sudo.halo/.CustomReceiver -a io.github.lamin_sudo.halo.CUSTOM \
  --es title "订单已发货" --es text "#4192 to Rafiq" \
  --ei 进度 60 --ei ttl 8 --es 颜色 0xFF30D158 --es 键顺序-4192
````

需要`-n`（或至少`-p io.github.lamin_sudo.halo`）——对自定义行为的隐式广播离子是
自 Android 8 起已删除。在 Tasker 中，使用 *Send Broadcast* 并填写包字段。重复
同样的消息，它再次显示：接收者碰撞序列号，这就是事件。

## 设置

存储在 `a79_island_*` 下的 `Settings.Global` 中，因为这是挂钩 SystemUI 的地方
进程可以读取；更改通过“ContentObserver”实时应用，无需重新启动。

|关键|意义|默认|
|---|---|---|
| `已启用` |主开关|上 |
| `src_notification`、`src_media`、`src_charging`、`隐私` |每个源开关|上 |
| `触觉` |点击和滑动即可发出嗡嗡声|上 |
| `game_hide` |当 Game Space 拥有屏幕时隐藏 |上 |
| `沉浸式隐藏` |顶部应用程序隐藏状态栏时隐藏|上 |
| `隐藏头向上` |打压ColorOS自己的旗帜|关闭 |
| `ttl_ms` |胶囊能停留多长时间？ 5000 |
| `offset_x`、`offset_y`、`width_scale` |位置，以 px 和 % 为单位 | 0, 0, 100 | 0, 0, 100 |
| `allow_<pkg>` |每个应用程序门 |允许 |
| `调试日志` |标签 `HaloIsland` 下的详细 logcat |关闭 |

## 已知限制，明确说明

- **未检测到麦克风关闭的录音机。** ColorOS 录制时不带麦克风
  MediaProjection 令牌，因此唯一幸存的信号是麦克风操作。
- **全屏检测是针对每个信号的。** 游戏和“顶部应用程序隐藏栏”都是真实的
  WindowManager/游戏空间事实。保持状态栏可见的视频不是全屏的，因为
  就系统而言，岛屿仍然存在。
- **对于未设置 `deleteIntent` 的应用程序，无法将行滑走** — `NotificationManager`
  在此版本中不提供公开的每键取消。
- **发件人照片取决于应用程序。** `android.messages` 作为捆绑包的 `Parcelable[]` 到达
  在此 ROM 上，“Person”公开“getName()”而不是“getDisplayName()”；发送的应用程序
  两者都不会退回到应用程序图标。
- **电池成本尚未测量。** `tools/battery-soak.sh` 存在（两个相等的空闲窗口，
  模块关闭与环扫）但尚未运行。在此之前，将环境环视为
  无法量化——这就是为什么媒体环仅在某些内容实际播放时运行。

## 文档

- [docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](https://github.com/lamin-sudo/halo/blob/main/docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md) — 钩子图、塑造它的每个测量值以及四个路线
  在找到正确的信号之前失败了。
